approach_summary: Establish a trustworthy stratified 5-fold CV baseline before any feature engineering or ensembling. EDA shows strong linear signal (cloud +0.64, sunshine -0.56, humidity +0.45) and no categorical features, so a near-default LightGBM is the correct anchor; all later experiments get judged against this number. Drop the id column (pure identifier, ~0 correlation) and keep day as-is for now.

exp_001 established a strong LightGBM baseline (CV roc_auc 0.8854). EDA shows dominant linear signal (cloud +0.64, sunshine -0.56, humidity +0.45) and a day-of-year column with no cyclical encoding. Add cheap, physically-motivated features — cyclical day encoding (sin/cos), cloud-sunshine and humidity-dewpoint interactions, diurnal temp range (maxtemp-mintemp), and drop the pure-identifier id column — so the GBM can exploit seasonality and interaction structure it cannot see in raw columns. This is the highest-leverage next step before considering a new model family or ensemble.
